high.title: New DHE Natural Resources Must Be Parked at State Banks Starting Tomorrow, Compliant Exporters Get Rewards
high.summary: New regulation requiring natural resource export proceeds to be placed in three state banks (Mandiri, BRI, BNI) takes effect June 1, 2026. Finance Minister announces 100% compliance required with tax incentives for compliant exporters, significantly impacting foreign exchange management.

high.title: Coal and Palm Oil Exports Must Report to DSI Starting Tomorrow
high.summary: One-gate export policy for natural resources through PT DSI begins June 1, 2026 as transition period. All coal, palm oil, and ferroalloy exporters must report activities through DSI while continuing normal operations, marking major shift in export governance.

high.title: Prabowo Reveals Reason for One-Gate Natural Resource Exports Through DSI
high.summary: President Prabowo explains new export policy aims to prevent foreign control of Indonesian commodity pricing and stop profit leakage abroad. Policy seeks to ensure more economic value from natural resources stays domestically and reduce state revenue losses.

high.title: Indonesia's Strategy to Reduce USD Dependence After Dollar Hits Rp 17,900
high.summary: Government implements fiscal strategy to reduce USD dependence through non-USD debt issuance after dollar reached Rp 17,900. Deputy Finance Minister highlights Indonesia's economic resilience amid global uncertainty through energy mix and prudent fiscal policy.

high.title: Warning for Middle Class as US Dollar Weakens Rupiah
high.summary: Rupiah weakens to Rp 17,881/USD with potential to breach Rp 18,000 next week. Economist warns of significant impact on import prices, electronics, and food commodities, creating import inflation concerns for consumers and businesses.

high.title: New Pertamina Fuel Prices: Pertamax Turbo Increases
high.summary: Pertamina raises Pertamax Turbo price by Rp 850 to Rp 20,750/liter starting June 1, while Dexlite and Pertamina Dex prices decrease by Rp 3,000 and Rp 3,100 respectively. Price adjustments reflect market conditions and impact consumer costs.

medium.title: Danantara to Announce DSI Executive Names Next Week
medium.summary: Danantara COO announces new executive appointments for PT DSI next week beyond current CEO Luke Thomas Mahony. Company emphasizes strict selection process and transparency development for the new state export entity.

medium.title: Deputy Agriculture Minister Guarantees State Enterprise PT DSI Won't Seek Profit, Asks Businesses Not to Worry
medium.summary: Deputy Agriculture Minister assures that DSI will operate as transparent manager and supervisor without taking profits. Aims to address palm industry concerns following TBS price drops and minimize state losses from dubious export practices.

medium.title: Danantara Delays Financial Report Announcement, Here's the Reason
medium.summary: Danantara COO explains delayed financial reporting due to complex consolidation of all state enterprises under management. Major governance cleanup and asset impairment resolution ongoing, with report expected mid-2026.

medium.title: 13th Month Salary for Civil Servants to Retirees Disbursed Starting Tomorrow
medium.summary: TASPEN begins distributing 13th month salary and holiday allowances for civil servants and retirees starting June 2, 2026. Policy follows Presidential Regulation No. 9/2026 providing additional income support for government employees.

medium.title: Prabowo Discusses Economic Growth, Calls for Honest Assessment of Reality
medium.summary: President questions whether economic growth benefits are distributed fairly across all Indonesians. Calls for honest evaluation of economic development aligned with Pancasila values and acknowledgment of existing challenges.

medium.title: Indonesia's Gold Export Benchmark Price Falls
medium.summary: Trade Ministry sets new gold export benchmark price down 1.43% to $148,396.49/kg for first half of June 2026. Decline reflects global gold correction as investors shift to yield-bearing instruments over non-yielding gold assets.

medium.title: Prabowo Entrusts Fast Train Affairs to AHY
medium.summary: President appoints Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure AHY as Chairman of Jakarta-Bandung High Speed Rail Committee, replacing Luhut Pandjaitan. Change reflects cabinet restructuring for improved effectiveness in infrastructure projects.

medium.title: US Closes Loopholes for Advanced Chip Exports to Chinese Companies
medium.summary: US Commerce Department closes regulatory gaps allowing advanced AI chips to reach Chinese companies through overseas subsidiaries. New rules require licensing for China-headquartered companies to obtain advanced US AI chips globally.

medium.title: Danantara CEO Meets French Corporate Giants, Here's What Was Discussed
medium.summary: Investment Minister and Danantara CEO Rosan Roeslani meets with major French companies including Amundi, Eramet, and JCDecaux in Paris. Discussions cover investment, asset management, strategic industry development, and urban infrastructure innovation partnerships.

medium.title: Civil Servants WFH Once a Week Saves Government Budget Rp 1.95 Trillion
medium.summary: PANRB Ministry reports weekly work-from-home policy for civil servants saves Rp 1.95 trillion in official travel costs plus Rp 65.6 billion in utilities. Policy also accelerates digital transformation with 100,817 additional electronic signature documents.
